purpose: Campus AP score research for Articulate DAG; this file does not change graph.js or establish Chabot prerequisite clearance.

coverage.exam_index: 43 current AP subjects plus the Calculus BC AB subscore
coverage.scope: Published central campus charts and specified college contexts. This is not an audit of every degree program or every historical exam year. Unlisted subjects remain unresolved.

excluded.UCSF: No undergraduate transfer AP-credit program in this comparison.

unresolved_items: Merced campus-catalog access blocked; UC Admissions summary used with manual review.
Berkeley has no universal major equivalence; Haas/CED/Rausser and individual major rules are outside the encoded college contexts.
UCLA schools beyond The College and Samueli require their own tables.
CSUEB conflicting Drawing/3-D Design rows and undated policy need registrar confirmation.
New AP career subjects have no verified campus-specific awards in the reviewed charts.

interpretation.score_5: Highest AP scaled score; not a requirement to answer every exam question correctly.
interpretation.units_vs_requirements: University units, campus GE, Cal-GETC certification, course equivalence, placement, and major applicability are separate decisions.
interpretation.course_credit: Text preserves alternatives, ranges and petitions. Do not parse it as a flat completed-course array.
interpretation.rules: Match campus, college/major context, score, exam year and conditions. Rules are alternatives unless explicitly additive; never sum overlapping rules.
interpretation.unknown: not_listed is not a denial of credit. null is unknown; an empty course list means none listed in that specific chart.
interpretation.transfer_route: Use the separate ap_uc_calgetc_credit.json for Cal-GETC. A campus prohibition on direct AP GE does not automatically invalidate certified transfer GE.
interpretation.unit_caps: Apply overlap and exam-family caps before summing units. Same content cannot automatically earn exam and course credit.
interpretation.review_gate: manual_review is required for policy conflicts, unclear dates, petitions and degree-specific application. Do not automatically mark a Chabot course completed using a UC or CSU course award.
